description.value: Whenever a creature damages you and you do not act against it before the start of your next turn, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll or Rite spell attack roll against that creature, stacking up to +4. The bonus resets against a creature once you act against it. Wrath doesn't need to be spent right away. It just needs to be spent eventually.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Whenever a creature damages you and you don't act against it before your next turn: +1 circumstance to your next attack/Rite-attack vs that creature, stacking to +4; resets once you act against it" needs a per-creature bonus that STACKS across repeated triggers and resets on a condition -- a strictly larger ask than TokenMark's boolean mark/unmark (the mechanism this corpus's own cult-sign-effect.json and real pf2e's hunt-prey.json both use). No precedent found for a numeric, stacking, per-creature counter anywhere in this pass's research; even a companion Effect card couldn't cleanly carry a stacking counter with tools confirmed in this pass, so this is a firmer INCOMPLETE than the ordinary P-NEEDS-COMPANION gap.
